sonnet.problem: The fill-in-the-blank asks the baker to supply the missing word of a line ("tell" versus "train" or "bless"). Card 6 never says why Zion is toured, so nothing earlier lets the baker reason out the purpose. The pick is a guess at wording, not an informed guess about meaning.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
